Defined in: core/tokens/starfield/params/weather.ts:133

Solar-wind activity cycle — one shared uniform drives the sun's flare frequency AND every aurora shell, so a storm spike on the Sun visibly reaches Earth/Jupiter/Saturn/Neptune a beat later. BASE+WAVE give the slow ~11-year-style swell; the storm term multiplies two detuned sines and takes a high power so spikes stay rare and sharp.
